name: hud_ui_mgr_disable_hud
description: HudUiMgr::DisableHud hides active HUD widgets, clears transient HUD state, disables the active layout, disables alternate clipping, and returns the previous enabled state.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper is deferred to a coherent HUD/source-cluster tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x410ed0 validates returning the previous g_HudUiMgr.enabled value, destroying the sensor window, hiding both widgets for all 32 weapon slots, clearing sensor target marker count and weapon state, disabling the HUD container and current layout, hiding objective widgets/panels/meter, disabling alternate clipping, setting layout delay for perspective HUD mode, and keeping the timer panel visible.

The native smoke verifies previous-state return, container disable dispatch, layout disable dispatch, weapon-slot visibility order, objective visibility order, timer-panel visibility, sensor/weapon state clears, alternate clipping disable, and perspective layout-delay assignment.
